title: Keep a fire going
kid_text: Give it air and thin sticks.

steps.text: Open a gap so air hits the base.
Add fluff if it only smokes.
Add one thin stick at a time.
Do not lay a thick log on a new flame.
Near a shelter, keep the air moving.

mistakes.text: You pile on wrist-thick wood too soon.
mistakes.fix: Wait until the flame is the size of two hands.
